edge_construction: Conflict-only directed edge for a source-side choice; OTHER/PARSE_FAIL is UNRESOLVED. A source-label-consistent pair has relation SAME_LABEL and does not create a directed edge.
stable_graph: Both reciprocal pair orders select the same side; opposite choices are ORDER_SENSITIVE and remain order-specific.
stable_prediction: TWO_VS_ONE: the two cross-group conflict edges must each be stable and agree on the shared-versus-minority winner; the shared/shared pair is SAME_LABEL. ALL_DIFFERENT: all three conflict edges must be stable and form a transitive total order with a unique top label. Order-sensitive, cyclic, or unresolved cases yield UNRESOLVED.
order_conditioned_prediction: For each exact tri-modal order, use only pairwise outputs matching each conflict pair relative order. TWO_VS_ONE requires both cross-group conflict edges to agree; ALL_DIFFERENT requires all three edges to form a transitive tournament with a unique Condorcet winner. Any disagreement, cycle, or unresolved edge yields UNRESOLVED.
two_vs_one_rule: The two induced conflict edges between the shared-label group and minority-label group must both favor the same group; the consistent shared/shared pair is SAME_LABEL. Disagreement, unresolved edge, or cycle yields UNRESOLVED.
all_different_rule: Unique Condorcet winner if one label beats both alternatives and the remaining edge is consistent; directed cycle or any unresolved edge yields UNRESOLVED.
metrics: overall eligible correct rate counting unresolved as not resolved/correct
